title: Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23766v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints

translated_title: 逻辑引导的图去噪扩散模型
translated_abstract: 图扩散模型是生成复杂图结构数据的有竞争力的方法。然而，当这类数据分布具有严格的结构约束时，扩散模型可能无法精确捕捉这些约束，从而导致生成无效的图。在本文中，我们提出了一种通过一阶逻辑（FOL）将图扩散模型与特定领域知识相结合的方法，利用其富有表现力且可解释的形式化体系对生成过程施加结构约束。我们采用分类器引导（classifier guidance）技术来融入领域知识，该技术通过将扩散模型的分布条件化于外部变量来控制采样数据。在生成过程中，分类器引导引导去噪轨迹以优化一个目标函数，我们将该目标函数定义为逻辑规则的模糊且可微的松弛形式。我们的方法只需要指定约束条件即可。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于一阶逻辑（FOL）的分类器引导方法，通过将逻辑规则松弛为模糊可微的目标函数来引导扩散模型的去噪轨迹，从而使生成的图数据满足严格的结构约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a classifier guidance method based on First Order Logic (FOL) that steers the denoising trajectory of graph diffusion models by relaxing logical rules into a fuzzy, differentiable objective function, enabling the generation of graphs that satisfy strict structural constraints.
